S1037.reason: An assignee of an assignable real estate contract steps into the buyer's shoes and can seek specific performance against an unjustifiably refusing seller.

S0107.reason: Personal immunity attaches to the individual in a personal capacity and does not cover conduct of the State as such.

S0341.reason: Normal adult respiratory rate is roughly 12-20 breaths per minute, with 14-16 a common reference value.
